page.layout: One centred block of title lines in the upper half, with the engraved woodcut border and imprint below. Left margin and right margin empty apart from library stamps, which are omitted.

main_text.l: IN QUIBUS ET RELIQUA CATHOLICAE RE-
ligionis nostræ Capita pasim, non prætermissis orthodoxorum
etiam Patrum sententijs, ita tractantur, ut Christianus

l.i: Accesere [?] etiam de IURAMENTO & USURA Appendices

page.notes: Engraved woodcut border with a central medallion showing a seated figure with a hammer or axe and flanking figures, with a putto at the top; no text inside the engraving. Library stamp ("BIBL. COLL. ALUMNORUM") and a university stamp at the foot are omitted, as is the handwritten mark in the upper right corner. "Accesere" is read as printed with the long s rendered as plain s; the word is uncertain, hence [?]. "VVOLFGANGVM" is printed with VV for W and is kept as printed.
